scope: Read-only verification of frozen inputs; no experimental output rewritten

M3.pipeline: RGB + calibration + OpenVINS estimated metric camera-to-world pose -> MapAnything (pose and scale conditioning enabled) -> optical-Z depth -> Astra packet
M3.pose_source: OpenVINS output; not MapAnything output pose
M3.limitation: This audit verifies file/data conventions and passthrough; it does not prove physical clock accuracy, sensor calibration accuracy, sufficient excitation, or estimator optimality.

M2_depth_branch.approximation_note: Not direct map.project_map call: frozen slam_map.pt stores a dict and project_map requires CUDA. Logic is mirrored for neighborhood selection, world_to_camera transform, pinhole projection, valid-point tests and 10x10 occupancy.
M2_depth_branch.rest_branch: PriorDA because rest invocation skips index 0, so local min_uv_score remains initialized to 1.0; it does not inherit or recompute keyframe score.
